entries.04ea3b23ce3ce024: C'BON COSMETICS Co.,Ltd. has its head office in Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, and is a company that manufactures and sells cosmetics and quasi-drugs.
entries.09983b914fe35127: A company that manufactures cosmetics, mainly skincare products, at its own factory, and provides counseling-based sales at membership salons together with after-purchase service as an integrated offering.
entries.0d0fe6c9b844c6a8: This is because the 【Business Description】 section states that the company sells products manufactured at its production center through mail-order sales and at its membership-based facialist salons, and that for members who purchase cosmetics it checks skin condition and provides skincare advice based on counseling, facial services and other after-sales services.
entries.1459038ca7ece548: Its distinguishing feature is an integrated structure in which cosmetics manufactured at its own factory are sold through counseling at its own membership salons, and facial services continue after purchase.
entries.1e1060beadc22219: Designated to the First Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange
entries.234255d8a2bcc0a3: Beverages and food products such as beauty drinks
entries.30bf9b1e677f116f: The company registers customers of directly operated stores, facialist sales companies and mail order as members, awards points called "Beauty Up Points" according to the amount purchased of home-care products, and provides various after-sales services such as facial services according to the number of points. At customers' request, it also provides treatment services using separately purchased pack sets and similar products.
entries.340f2ca3ab99cc36: Manufactures cosmetics at its own factory and offers them combined with salon services
entries.35161853ffbc6a46: It manufactures cosmetics and quasi-drugs, centered on skincare products, at its production center in Tochigi Prefecture, and provides them in combination with various after-sales services such as counseling and facial services at membership salons.
entries.41f189a455d40b61: Cosmetics are manufactured at the production center in Kaminokawa-machi, Kawachi-gun, Tochigi Prefecture, which maintains third-party certification under "ISO22716" (cosmetics GMP), the international standard for quality and safety in cosmetics manufacturing.
entries.50be55816a07cd44: This business model sells cosmetics manufactured at its own factory through counseling-based sales at membership salons and mail-order sales, and leads to continued purchases through after-sales services such as facial services provided to members who have made purchases.
entries.557bde238735671e: This is because the 【Analysis of Financial Position, Operating Results and Cash Flows by Management】 section states that the cosmetics industry as a whole is being revitalized by more opportunities to go out and a recovery in inbound demand, that competition among brands has grown even more intense, and that revenue from the directly operated store business, the core business, has been trending upward.
entries.63c7fa2b6562a02f: Its distinguishing feature is an integrated structure in which cosmetics manufactured at its own factory are sold through counseling at its own membership salons, and facial services continue after purchase. Because it can continuously check the skin condition of each customer, it can propose skincare suited to that condition.
entries.65dc448fe40d7e5f: Its main customers are visiting customers of its membership salon "C'BON Facialist Salon" and customers who have purchased products and registered as members.
entries.6ba6b16833238e5e: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026: ¥213 million
entries.6c4854dfe5b27ecd: A cosmetics maker that, while the cosmetics market recovers and competition among brands intensifies, places its directly operated store business at the core, maintains relationships with existing customers through after-sales services for members, and also works to acquire new customers.
entries.70036525f2ae7561: Customers and members visiting members-only salons
entries.7260890f7115a7c6: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells cosmetics and quasi-drugs centered on skincare products. It sells products manufactured at its own plant, the Production Center in Tochigi Prefecture, through members-only "C'BON Facialist Salon," mail order, and domestic and overseas distributors, and provides members who make purchases with skin condition checks, counseling-based advice and various after-sales services such as facial services. The company and four subsidiaries form the group.
entries.80400a89d741c213: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,267 million, up 4.8% year on year. Sales at directly operated stores are the main source of revenue.
entries.80e44d94d73addc6: Its main customers are visiting customers of its membership salon "C'BON Facialist Salon" and customers who have purchased products and registered as members. Mail-order purchasers and domestic and overseas sales agents are also customers.
entries.896f8b70bb5a37aa: The fiscal year ended March 2026 is the final year of the medium-term management plan that started in the fiscal year ended March 2024. Under the vision of "Playing Beauty Together," it is addressing three priority issues, "enhancing product value," "enhancing salon value" and "creating new value," and is working to raise revenue and expand its customer base.

entries.d52a86c992461b15: At the members-only "C'BON Facialist Salon," beauty sales staff conduct counseling on customers' skin condition and sell cosmetics suited to their skin. For first-time customers, the company guides them to a trial plan where they can experience Oriental-style treatments and similar services. Other sales channels include mail order, domestic distributor sales and overseas distributor sales, and as of March 31, 2026 there were 99 directly operated stores and one customer-attraction base in Japan.

entries.dbd8cccdf64f8843: It manufactures cosmetics at its Production Center in Kaminokawa Town, Kawachi District, Tochigi Prefecture, and maintains third-party certification under "ISO22716" (cosmetics GMP), the international standard for quality and safety in cosmetics manufacturing. Manufacturing of makeup products and others is outsourced, and the packaging process for some products is carried out at the Production Center. The Research and Development Center, also in Kaminokawa Town, is the base for research and logistics, and the subsidiary Jafmac Co., Ltd. and external contractors also manufacture food and beverages such as beauty drinks.

entries.e9368479912105b7: C'BON COSMETICS Co.,Ltd. has its head office in Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, and is a company that manufactures and sells cosmetics and quasi-drugs. It forms a group with four subsidiaries, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 717.
entries.f6732f27943c14cf: Skincare products (basic products such as cleansers, facial washes, lotions and milky lotions)
entries.fab458155bf726ea: The fiscal year ended March 2026 is the final year of the medium-term management plan that started in the fiscal year ended March 2024. Under the vision of "Playing Beauty Together," it is addressing three priority issues, "enhancing product value," "enhancing salon value" and "creating new value," and is working to raise revenue and expand its customer base. In creating new value, it is focusing on expanding its hair business, expanding overseas sales channels, and the re-expansion of subsidiaries.
